summary: Azitra, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that on August 19, 2026, NYSE Regulation confirmed the company regained compliance with NYSE American continued listing standards, resolving deficiencies under Sections 1003(a)(ii) and (iii). The .BC indicator will be removed and the company removed from the noncompliant issuer list. The filing is a routine compliance update, not a special situation transaction. The company remains subject to monitoring, and a repeat noncompliance within 12 months could accelerate delisting procedures. No deal terms, premiums, or transaction structure apply.
